title: Brand Mention Sweep
description: Sweep X, Threads, and Reddit for fresh mentions of the client's brand and products, triage them by sentiment and urgency, and deliver a response-ready report.

inputs.label: Product or alternate names to search (optional extras)

nodes.title: Sweep X and Threads for mentions
nodes.detail: Search X and Threads for the brand name and each product name. Collect up to 15 recent mentions combined: URL, platform, author handle, mention text, approximate engagement, and posted time. Include replies and quote posts that reference the brand even without the exact handle.
nodes.acceptance: Recent X and Threads mentions collected with text and metadata (up to 15).

subtasks.title: Search brand and product terms on X
Search the same terms on Threads

outputScope.name: social_mentions
outputScope.description: Per-mention url, platform, author, text, engagement, posted_at

nodes.title: Sweep Reddit for brand discussions
nodes.detail: Search Reddit for the brand and product names. Collect up to 10 relevant threads or comments: URL, subreddit, title or comment text, upvotes, comment count, and age. Prioritize question threads and complaint threads — these need responses first.
nodes.acceptance: Relevant Reddit threads collected with context (up to 10).

subtasks.title: Search brand terms on Reddit
subtasks.purpose: Threads and comments mentioning the brand

outputScope.name: reddit_mentions
outputScope.description: Per-thread url, subreddit, text, upvotes, comments, age

nodes.title: Verify sweep coverage
nodes.detail: Check that both sweeps ran (empty results are acceptable only with an explicit 'no mentions found' status per platform), every collected mention has a URL and text, and there are no duplicate URLs across the two lists.

nodes.title: Write the triage report
nodes.detail: Classify every mention by sentiment (positive/neutral/negative) and urgency (respond today / respond this week / no action), then write a markdown report: (1) urgent items first, each with a suggested response draft, (2) sentiment summary counts per platform, (3) recurring themes worth a content response, (4) items to monitor. The account manager should be able to act from this report alone.
nodes.acceptance: All mentions triaged; urgent items include response drafts.

subtasks.title: Summarize themes and watch items
subtasks.purpose: Feed content ideas and next sweeps
